title: Affine derived decompositions lift to module decompositions
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an affine open and $R=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_X)$. Let $F_U$ be the actual affine sheafification functor of [lem-pc-affine-perfect-module-model], and choose derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] for $R$-modules and sheaf modules on the localized site over $U$, with arbitrary morphism universes. Let $P$ be an arbitrary cochain complex of $R$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] and $E,F$ objects of the localized sheaf derived category such that $Q(F_U(P))\cong E\oplus F$. There exist an additive functor $G:D(R)\to D(\mathcal O_U)$, a natural isomorphism $G\circ Q\cong Q\circ F_U^{\bullet}$, and $C,D\in D(R)$ with $Q(P)\cong C\oplus D$, $E\cong G(C)$, and $F\cong G(D)$. No boundedness, finiteness or pseudo-coherence hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 06Z0, perfect-lemma-affine-compare, elucidation of the derived tilde/Gamma adjunction; affine reduction of Tag 08CE

proof.text: Exactness of tilde: it preserves colimits by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction]. An injective module map induces injective maps on localized modules by [lem-weil-pbc-localization-module-exact], hence on sections of tilde, which are compatible localized families. In Lean this uses IsLocalizedModule.map_injective, Subtype.ext, and PresheafOfModules.mono_of_injective. Thus tilde preserves monomorphisms and cokernels, hence homology and finite limits.

Take [lem-pc-affine-qcoh-derived-equivalence] on Spec R and [lem-pc-affine-localized-site-derived-transport] to the localized site. Compose the affine equivalence functor, full-subcategory inclusion and transport into a fully faithful functor G. Whiskering their termwise comparisons gives Q followed by G naturally isomorphic to termwise F_U followed by Q. The exact tilde functor induces L.mapDerivedCategory. Localizations make precomposition with Q fully faithful, so descend the comparison to an isomorphism from that functor to the affine equivalence followed by inclusion. This proves additivity of G.

Derive the ordinary tilde/Gamma adjunction by [lem-sc-derived-adjunction-from-underived], using the proved unbounded exact-left-adjoint specialization Adjunction.mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction. Transport its left adjoint through the preceding functor isomorphism and compose with the transport equivalence adjunction. This gives G left adjoint to B, the transported derived sections functor.

The given decomposition and the comparison at P identify E ⊕ F with G(Q(P)); full faithfulness makes the counit there invertible (Adjunction.isIso_counit_app_of_iso). The binary inclusions and projections exhibit E and F as retracts of E ⊕ F. Apply NatTrans.retractArrowApp to the counit; isomorphisms are closed under retract arrows (MorphismProperty.isomorphisms.of_retract). Thus both individual counits are invertible. Put C=B(E), D=B(F) and use their inverse counits for the required isomorphisms. Additivity gives G(C ⊕ D) ≅ G(C) ⊕ G(D); compose with the decomposition and use G.preimageIso to lift to Q(P) ≅ C ⊕ D. All of this is proved categorical glue and also works on the empty affine open or with zero summands.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_derived_summand_models (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wR} (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.obj (.op U)))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.obj (.op U))) ℤ)
    (E F : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)))
    (h : Nonempty
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((affinePerfectSheafification X U hU).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≅
          E ⊞ F)) :
    ∃ G : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.obj (.op U))) ⥤
        DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)),
      G.Additive ∧ Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ G ≅
        (affinePerfectSheafification X U hU).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Q) ∧
      ∃ C D : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.obj (.op U))),
        Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ C ⊞ D) ∧
        Nonempty (E ≅ G.obj C) ∧ Nonempty (F ≅ G.obj D)
